lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a grid-like alignment where each major blob is centered upon a vertical intensity vector.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several thin, linear, low-contrast white striations are visible in the central and upper-left flank regions, indicating superficial epidermal abrasions or minor scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density clusters of secondary micro-spots (small high-luminance pixel groups) are situated in the interstitial spaces between the primary vertical columns, particularly towards the posterior right of the image.
